channel.title: Cash Memer News
channel.description: App updates, new features and release notes from Cash Memer.

item.title: Cash Memer Launches on the Web
item.description: The Cash Memer Web App is here — create professional receipts, manage inventory and price lists, and turn your phone into a wireless barcode scanner, all from any browser.

item.title: Cash Memer Announces Its Trademark Portfolio
item.description: Cash Memer has published the trademarks and brand identifiers it owns and uses — part of an ongoing brand-protection initiative — and asks partners, developers, media and third parties to respect these rights.

item.title: Cash Memer Launches on Google Play
item.description: Cash Memer makes its debut on Google Play — bringing AI receipt recognition, a financial-insights dashboard, live currency rates, GPS-stamped memos, digital signatures and secure Google-account cloud backup to Android, free.
